title: Newborn — overview
summary: Developmental stage Newborn (0-1 month). Newborn (0-1 month): Lifts head briefly during tummy time; startles at loud sounds; focuses on faces 8 to 12 inches away. Every child develops at their own pace; milestones are guides, not deadlines.
